newsitem.title: USA: OzEmail, BSkyB enter Internet venture.
newsitem.headline: OzEmail, BSkyB enter Internet venture.

text.p: OzEmail Ltd, an Australia-based Internet service provider, said on Wednesday that it formed a joint venture with British Sky Broadcasting Group Plc for global Internet advertising.
Each party will make an equal financial contribution to the joint venture, OzEmail said.

OzEmail said it has agreed to issue BSkyB, a U.K.-based pay television company, two-year options to acquire two million shares of OzEmail at US$14 each, or about 15 percent of OzEmail on a fully diluted basis.

Elisabeth Murdoch, general manager broadcasting BSkyB, and Malcolm Turnbull, chairman of OzEmail, have been appointed co-chairmen of the venture, OzEmail said. The financial contribution each company will make to the joint venture was not immediately available.

Based on technology developed by OzEmail, the joint venture will deliver Internet advertising opportunities targeted at local audiences accessing Web sites regardless of where those sites are hosted, OzEmail said.
Details of the technology and the joint venture's strategy will be made public on December 3, 1996, at its launch in New York.
